source_wording: The total curvature of a higher-dimensional manifold is related to a characteristic number.
canonical_statement: For a compact, oriented, boundaryless Riemannian manifold M of even dimension 2n, the integral over M of the Euler form obtained from the convention-normalized Pfaffian of the curvature of the Levi-Civita connection equals the Euler characteristic of M.

canonical_formal_target.blocker: The pinned Lean environment has not supplied a concrete end-to-end interface for the normalized curvature Pfaffian, manifold integration, and topological Euler characteristic.

domain_and_universes: A finite-dimensional smooth manifold M with a Riemannian metric, orientation, compactness, no boundary, and even dimension 2n; precise Lean universes and models remain open.
quantifiers: M : compact oriented boundaryless Riemannian manifold of dimension 2n
conclusion: The oriented integral of the normalized Pfaffian Euler form of the Levi-Civita curvature is equal to the Euler characteristic of M.

alternate_encodings.target: The de Rham Euler class evaluated on the fundamental class equals the Euler characteristic.
